name: Panchmel Dal
instructions: 1. Wash and soak all five dals together for 30 minutes.
2. Pressure cook the soaked dals with 3 cups of water, turmeric powder, and salt until soft (approx. 3-4 whistles).
3. Whisk the cooked dal gently to reach a uniform consistency.
4. Heat ghee in a small pan, add cumin seeds, asafoetida, and dry red chilies until they crackle.
5. Add the ginger and green chilies, sautéing for a minute.
6. Add red chili powder and coriander powder to the tempering, then immediately pour this mixture over the cooked dal.
7. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with Baati or steamed rice.
description: Panchmel Dal, also known as Dal Panchratna, is a royal delicacy from Rajasthan. It is traditionally served as a primary accompaniment to 'Dal Baati Churma'. Its blend of five different lentils provides a distinct texture and earthy flavor, reflecting the nutritional needs and culinary traditions of the desert state.
